notes: Six complete direction headings: 31 visually reviewed rows; 28 accepted nonstop schedules (8 Delta, 20 ASA), three through-stop rows excluded. No connecting rows occur within these six headings. Triangle and p4 number ranges identify ASA. All accepted rows have no dated footnotes.

Blank means daily; X6 excludes Saturday; X7 excludes Sunday; 6 is Saturday only. Each physical leg retains its own frequency. ATL–GSP 1405 is X7 while GSP–ATL 1405 is daily; ATL–GSP 1408 is daily while GSP–ATL 1408 is X6.

ATL–PFN 1481 and 1260 have one stop at Dothan. PFN–ATL 1253 has one stop at Dothan. The old ATL–DHN / DHN–ATL legs remain unchanged; only separately printed missing segments are added, with their own dates and times.

ATL–PFN 1478 is 11:47–12:07 Central; return departs 12:20, giving thirteen minutes on the ground. ATL–PFN 1480 is 16:50–17:05 Central; return departs 17:20. Magnified original confirms 17:05, not 17:50.

ASA 1481: old ATL–DHN 18:45–18:55 Central; new DHN–PFN 19:05–19:35; new PFN–ATL 19:50–22:10 Eastern. Ten minutes at DHN and fifteen at PFN. All three legs are X6. No invented nonstop ATL–PFN or DHN–ATL leg.
ASA 1253 PFN–DHN 06:45–07:15 joins old DHN–ATL at 07:25. ASA 1260 old ATL–DHN arrives 20:35 Central and new DHN–PFN departs 20:45. Both have ten-minute ground intervals.

ATL–GSP 1410 is Saturday only, 11:47–12:52; GSP–ATL 1410 is also Saturday only, 13:05–14:10. Thirteen minutes on the ground. ATL–GSP 1409 is 22:55–23:55 on the same local date, though both UTC timestamps are the following date.

ATL/GSP use winter UTC−5; PFN/DHN use UTC−6. All 28 accepted schedules arrive on the same local calendar day. Exact-window overlap can retain flights partly outside the window; whole timestamps remain intact.

Independent 24-hour transcription, fixed winter offsets, arrival-day offsets, weekdays and exact overlap match generated movements. Eleven same-number transitions in the window have independently checked ground intervals of 10–15 minutes; they do not establish aircraft identity.

Directory p261 identifies PFN Bay County, p260 identifies GSP Greenville/Spartanburg. Official airport histories and current site records distinguish old PFN from modern ECP, and GSP from the separate city airports. Coordinates mark approximate airport areas, not historical gates or terminals.

All prior movements, schedules, airlines and airports unchanged, including earlier corrections and all three held conflicts. Timetable end date, later amendments and actual operation unverified. Original scans not redistributed.
